How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur is 30-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M.Tech./M.E./M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech. in disciplines like Applied Geology, Hydrogeology, Geophysics, Water Resources Engineering, Geomatics/Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing & GIS, or other relevant allied fields.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page by clicking the provided link.
